rationale: The claim accurately characterizes AMLAS Version 1.1 according to its published text: it defines six iterative lifecycle stages linking system safety requirements to ML assurance artifacts, explicitly restricts its scope to the ML component, cautions against use in isolation from wider system standards, and states a primary focus on offline supervised learning. No evidence in the packet or artifact uses overclaims regulatory acceptance or whole-system safety approval.
evidence_locators: S-CHAL-004, PDF pp. 2–3, Introduction and Overview of AMLAS
S-CHAL-004, PDF p. 3, Using this Document
limitations: Review is restricted to University of York AMLAS Version 1.1 (March 2021) and does not evaluate downstream sector adaptations, proprietary application cases, or subsequent academic/industry extensions.
